text:
incidence_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: increased tail latency and error spikes for embeddings in eu-west-1. Auto-alert triggered for >200ms p99 and a rise in 502s. Paging oncall.
olivia_oncall: seeing lots of timeouts from the shard-fetcher when pulling model shards from artifact-store-eu. Example from logs: `GET https://artifacts-eu.redwood.internal/models/xyz/shard-12 504`
raj_sre: corroborating with network metrics — elevated tcp retransmits and >95% utilization on the egress NAT gateway for eu-west-1. Suspect recent firewall rule change pushed yesterday.
hana_mlinfra: temporary mitigation: switch serving pools to use cached local shards (fall back to local copy) and disable remote shard prefetch for new sessions. Applying to pool: hosted-eu-gen-1.
maria_prod: status page updated: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1770123456 — Impact: increased latency and intermittent failures for embeddings & generation in EU; mitigation in progress. Draft customer advisory ready: https://docs.google.com/draft/incident-1770123456 (internal).
cs_team: received a few priority customer tickets about slower responses; linking to status page and offering to retry jobs.
net_infra: investigating firewall rules, rolling back the ACL change from 2026-04-02T03:10Z which updated allowed egress IP ranges. Confirming rollback now.
olivia_oncall: after rollback, tcp retransmits falling and artifact fetch success rate climbing back to normal. p99 latency improving but still slightly elevated due to backlog.
raj_sre: additional mitigation: temporarily increase egress bandwidth limit on eu NAT gateway and kick stale shard-download workers to free sockets. Kicked job-worker group 24.
hana_mlinfra: after switching to local cached shards and clearing backlog, error-rate dropped to baseline on patched pools. Will keep remote prefetch disabled until we validate artifact-store resilience.
maria_prod: status updated: "Mitigation applied: local shard-fallback + NAT ACL rollback. Monitoring for 1 hour." Customer advisory sent to impacted customers.
net_infra: post-rollback note: found ACL rule that inadvertently prioritized a deny before an allow for artifact-store CIDR block — root cause introduced by scripting change.
olivia_oncall: postmortem owner: raj_sre. Action items: 1) add test that validates egress ACL ordering in infra CI, 2) add alert for artifact-store fetch error-rate >1% for 5min, 3) implement graceful degraded-path for shard fetch failures.
cs_team: following up with impacted customers, no data lost, performance restored to baseline.
incidence_bot: RESOLVED signal at 1770125200 — services stable, incident closed. Postmortem request created: https://redwood.internal/pm/1770123456-postmortem
